responsibility: This header defines the text-art widget hierarchy, the module’s compositional layout API for diagrams that need recursive sizing and positioning before rendering. It declares the abstract widget contract, cached requested-size and allocated-rectangle state, container and leaf subclasses, and concrete helper widgets such as wrapper_widget, vbox_widget, text_widget, and canvas_widget, providing the common two-phase layout interface that produces canvases from structured diagram elements.
same_name_distinction: Declares the widget hierarchy, cached geometry state, and common interfaces for wrapper, container, leaf, vbox, text, and canvas widgets; unlike gcc/text-art/widget.cc, it is the type structure and API surface, not the implementation.
